title: Synthesia Launches Syren AI to Generate Video via Code
summary:
A new generative application allows users to transform text prompts or documents into finished, agency-quality videos with real time editing capabilities. The tool, called Syren, uses an artificial intelligence agent to write videos as code, which are then played back through a proprietary rendering engine to support 3D graphics and reduce latency. Users refine the output through a chat interface using the Opus 5.5 model to adjust visual content and style.

Synthesia opened early access to the software on October 9, making it free to try via web browser or Claude MCP. The system learns a company's brand identity—including colors, typography, and pacing—by analyzing previously uploaded video libraries. It also supports integration with external data sources like Notion to automate the production of marketing and educational material.

selectedTweets.text:
Today, we are opening early access to Syren, a breakthrough in video generation: https://t.co/14yaOTyb6O 

Syren is an app from @synthesiaIO that turns a prompt or materials you already have into a finished video that is built live and refined by chat.

Three things set it apart:

1. Its own engine. Syren's agent writes the video as code and our own rendering engine plays it back live, handling motion and advanced 3D graphics - a new approach to video generation

2. Live preview and your own material. Describe the video, or add documents, images, videos or a connected source such as Notion, and watch it take shape instead of waiting on a long generation step.

3. Speed. The video renders in real time as it is built, with lower latency and better token efficiency than similar products.

I've been using it myself for the past week and I can honestly say it's been one of the most amazing products we've ever built!
